mappingGuidance.human_anatomy_break: Global visible body structure is anatomically implausible or unreadable.
mappingGuidance.joint_continuity_break: A visible joint chain becomes disconnected or implausible.
mappingGuidance.seated_pose_break: Pelvis/legs/stool relationship does not read as a viable seated pose.
mappingGuidance.limb_occlusion_order_break: Front/back ordering of limbs or body overlaps becomes unreadable.
mappingGuidance.seat_contact_inconsistency: Pelvis/skirt/legs do not make coherent contact with the stool/seat.
mappingGuidance.drum_contact_semantics_break: Intended strike/pedal action is contradicted by visible contact.
mappingGuidance.stick_continuity_break: Stick is broken, interrupted, malformed or visually discontinuous.
mappingGuidance.stick_hand_connection_break: Hand/grip and stick do not connect coherently.
mappingGuidance.line_artifact_break: Unexplained line artifact damages pose or silhouette reading.
mappingGuidance.waistline_artifact_break: Unexplained line appears around waist/pelvis area.
mappingGuidance.skirt_seat_overlap_break: Skirt/seat/body overlap linework is physically or visually incoherent.
mappingGuidance.line_double_stroke_break: Accidental duplicate line corrupts contour or silhouette.
mappingGuidance.fixed_drum_composite_break: Frame may look acceptable alone but fails anatomy/contact/occlusion when composited with fixed drum.

promotionPolicy.missingMandatoryQA: Do not use VERIFIED or APPROVED_LIVE.
